summary: Comprehensive backend (pytest) and frontend (Playwright) testing of Między Wierszami cafe/bookstore site. 23/23 backend tests passed; all critical frontend flows (auth, menu, bookstore, cart, Stripe checkout, admin panel CRUD) verified working.
critical_code_review_comments: Cookie auth uses samesite=none + secure which is correct for cross-origin. Bearer fallback works in get_current_user. Good.
/api/orders accepts a JSON array body but FastAPI auto-generates docs may be a bit odd; consider wrapping in a Pydantic model for clarity (not a bug).
/api/users/{user_id}/role takes role as query param (not body) - works but unconventional; consider Pydantic body model.
BookstorePage: add-to-cart button is only shown inside the book details dialog (after clicking a book card). Intentional design, documented for next testers.
Stripe webhook endpoint exists at /api/webhook/stripe but cannot be reached via ingress unless /api prefix routes are mapped (they are). OK.
passlib bcrypt - bcrypt warns about __about__ in some versions; not blocking.
test_credentials: admin@miedzywierszami.pl / Admin123! and test@example.com / Test123! both verified working
seed_data_creation: Test users with TEST_ prefix were created via backend tests; one TEST announcement created via admin UI - all data isolated by TEST_ prefix. No production data modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bookstore add-to-cart flow: click book card -> dialog opens -> click [data-testid=add-to-cart-btn]. The /cart route is a ProtectedRoute requiring login (cookie or Bearer token). Stripe redirect to checkout.stripe.com confirmed working with PLN currency. Auth uses both httpOnly cookie (samesite=none, secure) and Bearer header. For backend testing use cookies.get('session_token') from login response. 401 errors on initial /auth/me load before login are expected (unauthenticated baseline check).
verified_flows: Stripe payment checkout session creation (real Stripe test API)
Frontend: Stripe redirect to checkout.stripe.com works
Users list (admin), role update via query param
Homepage with OpenStreetMap (Leaflet) renders at Szczecin
